newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: IBCA AFFIRMS NU-WORLD DOMESTIC RATINGS.
newsitem.headline: IBCA AFFIRMS NU-WORLD DOMESTIC RATINGS.

text.p: Rating Agency IBCA on Monday reaffirmed Nu-World Holdings Ltd domestic short-term rating at A3 and BBB- for its long term rating.

"These investment grade ratings indicate obligations for which there is a low expectation of investment risk with adequate capacity for the timely repayment of principal and interest," IBCA said in a statement.

Nu-world which accounts for approximately 50 percent of the total domestic small electrical appliance market, stood to benefit from the steadily increasing delivery of mass housing and electrification programmes.

The rapid growth in export volumes and a wider geographic spread of earnings source also reduce the company's reliance on the South African appliance market and fluctuations in general domestic economic conditions.

IBCA said the goup had maintained strong earnings growth over the past five years and profitability had remained fairly steady. Gearing had also declined as retained earnings and recent rights issues had strengthened the groups's equity base giving the group greater financial flexibility.
